status: on by default, no benefit for voice prefix
decision_reason: vLLM 0.32 enable_prefix_caching=True by default (engine config log, CacheConfig). It caches full 16-token KV blocks; our prompts share only 5 tokens ([128259, 128000, 't', 'ara', ':']), less than one block, so different texts get no reuse. Identical repeated prompts (e.g. the load test's two fixed texts) do reuse blocks; prefill is ~14 ms at N=1, so the effect on TTFA is small. Nothing built.
